text: ὁ ὑπερβρέφος βάλλει τὴν ἐρυθρὰν σφαῖραν πρὸς τὴν Γλαῦκα. ὁ ὑπερβρέφος καὶ ἡ Γλαὺξ χαίρουσιν.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a small gray stone that fits in one hand
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos sits with his arm extended and a joyful smile, having just thrown the red ball
Glaux hovers in the air with a happy expression, preparing to catch the approaching ball
The bright red leather ball flies through the air between Hyperbrephos and Glaux
The white leather ball remains on the ground near Hyperbrephos
The small gray stone sits unused beside Hyperbrephos
The large gray boulder stays in the background
